title: Eval harness: a case set per spec, run offline through the runner

story.i_want_to: a small eval set per spec that runs without production
story.so_that: a prompt or spec change is measured before it ships, not discovered on a live ticket

rationale: The guide's advice the loop skipped: evals before scale. Today quality is learned one live ticket at a time.

acceptance_criteria.description: An eval case is a JSON file eval/<spec>/<case>.json in loopctl-runner: {spec, version, input (the dispatch object exactly as sent), fixture repo + pinned commit, expectations}; expectations are deterministic first (schema-valid, outcome allowed, required escalation codes, lens agreement, forbidden content), a rubric only where text quality is the point.

mix loopctl_runner.eval <spec> runs each case through the runner's own launcher in a scratch detached worktree of a local fixture clone, with no control socket, and reads the result off disk; it prints a per-case pass/fail table and exits non-zero on any failure.
loopctl replays recorded eval results through its pure screens (GateA.evaluate, the triage screens, InjectionDetector) in its test suite beside DeliveryGates.Measurement.
Seed sets: triage@1 and reply_draft@1 at least five synthetic cases each; implement@1 at least three cases on a fixture repo. No real ticket text (PRD default 1).
The eval never reaches a production repository, the production socket or a customer.

test_cases.name: runs offline
steps: run the eval with the network to loopctl blocked

test_cases.name: failing case fails the run
steps: a case whose expectation cannot hold

test_cases.name: replay in loopctl
expected_results: same screen codes as the live path

technical_notes: The implement agent inherits ~/.claude on its machine in pr mode, so implement eval results are machine-dependent until the template pins what it inherits; record the machine with each result.
